speaker: Doctor
text: The echocardiogram confirms a patent ductus arteriosus causing the continuous murmur, and the hearing test shows bilateral sensorineural loss. Given the triad of these findings plus your history of bluish non-blanching skin macules and cloudy lenses, I am ready to conclude the evaluation. DIAGNOSIS READY: Rubinstein-Taybi Syndrome with associated congenital heart defect (PDA) and sensorineural hearing loss.
